shortDescription: Manage RADIUS server configuration on SONiC

options.name: config
options.description: Specifies the radius server related configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the operation to be performed on the radius server configured on the device. In case of merged, the input mode configuration will be merged with the existing radius server configuration on the device. In case of deleted the existing radius server mode configuration will be removed from the device. In case of replaced, the existing radius server configuration will be replaced with provided configuration. In case of overridden, the existing radius server configuration will be overridden
